# F9 Finance

> > F9 Finance accelerates finance careers through automation training, Excel mastery, and workflow optimization tools.

F9 Finance, led by Mike Dion, provides comprehensive finance automation resources including courses, templates, and corporate training designed to help finance professionals reclaim time and boost efficiency. The platform combines hands-on automation labs with strategic financial storytelling and AI prompting techniques.

## Key Topics

- Finance Automation
- Excel Automation
- Power BI
- Power Query
- FP&A
- Month-End Close
- Workflow Optimization
- Finance Operations
- Excel Templates
- Spreadsheet Optimization
- Process Automation
- Finance Career Development
- AI Prompting
- Financial Storytelling
- Automation Training

## Core Courses & Programs

- [Finance Automation Accelerator](https://www.f9finance.com/finance-automation-accelerator): 30-day Finance Automation Accelerator course to reclaim 40+ hours monthly.
- [Finance Automation Lab](https://www.f9finance.com/finance-automation-lab): Finance Automation Lab resource with workflow templates and training.
- [Finance Automation Courses](https://www.f9finance.com/courses): Main courses page featuring Finance Automation Lab and Accelerator offerings.
- [Master AI Prompting For Finance In 1 Hour](https://www.f9finance.com/product/master-ai-prompting-for-finance): One-hour course on AI prompting with ChatGPT for finance workflows.
- [The Financial Storyteller's Playbook](https://www.f9finance.com/product/the-financial-storytellers-playbook): One-hour playbook on data-driven financial storytelling and presentations.

## Training & Resources

- [Finance Automation Resources](https://www.f9finance.com/finance-automation-resources): Central hub for Excel templates, Power BI tools, and automation resources.
- [Corporate Automation Training](https://www.f9finance.com/corporate-automation-training): Finance On Autopilot and custom corporate training for finance teams.
